isomap.death.name: Death
isomap.settings.title: IsoMap settings
isomap.settings.sound_test.hint: Plays the sound of adding a waypoint.
isomap.settings.key.hint: Click, then press a key or mouse button. Delete unbinds, Esc cancels.
isomap.setting.general.enabled.hint: Turns the HUD minimap on or off.
isomap.setting.general.showCoords.hint: Shows your position under the minimap.
isomap.setting.general.showBiome.hint: Shows the current biome under the minimap.
isomap.setting.general.showCompass.hint: N, E, S and W letters on the edge of the map.
isomap.setting.general.hideWithDebugScre: Hides the minimap while the debug screen is open.
isomap.setting.general.uiAnimations.hint: Hover growth, press flash and fade-ins in the interface.
isomap.setting.minimap.size.hint: Side of the square map, in GUI units.
isomap.setting.minimap.anchor.hint: Screen corner the map is attached to.
isomap.setting.minimap.offsetX.hint: Distance from the side of the screen.
isomap.setting.minimap.offsetY.hint: Distance from the top or bottom of the screen.
isomap.setting.minimap.render3d.hint: Off shows a flat map, seen from straight above.
isomap.setting.minimap.terrainLayers.hin: Floating blocks, tree crowns and trunks in their real shape. Off fills everything down to the ground, slightly lighter.
isomap.setting.minimap.renderDistanceChu: Radius in chunks. Beyond 12 the map switches to a coarser mesh.
isomap.setting.minimap.updateFps.hint: Redraw rate while the camera is at rest. A moving camera always redraws every frame.
isomap.setting.minimap.terrainRefreshSec: How often nearby chunks are checked for changes.
isomap.setting.minimap.followSmoothing.h: 0% sticks to the player, higher values lag softly behind.
isomap.setting.minimap.heightScale.hint: Stretches or flattens the terrain vertically.
isomap.setting.minimap.supersample.hint: Renders at double resolution for clean edges. Slightly more GPU work.
isomap.setting.minimap.caveMode.hint: Automatic shows a section of the caves at your height while you are underground.
isomap.setting.camera.sensitivity.hint: How fast the mouse turns the map camera.
isomap.setting.camera.invertYaw.hint: Reverses the horizontal mouse axis of the map camera.
isomap.setting.camera.invertPitch.hint: Reverses the vertical mouse axis of the map camera.
isomap.setting.camera.pitchMin.hint: Lowest angle above the ground the camera can reach.
isomap.setting.camera.pitchMax.hint: Highest angle; 90 degrees looks straight down.
isomap.setting.camera.yawLimit.hint: How far the camera may turn away from north up; 180 is free.
Seconds until the camera returns to north up; 0 is off.
isomap.setting.waypoints.labels.hint: When waypoint names appear on the map.
isomap.setting.waypoints.showDistance.hi: Adds the distance to waypoint names.
isomap.setting.waypoints.edgeMarkers.hin: Pins far waypoints to the map edge in their direction.
isomap.setting.waypoints.deathMarkers.hi: Saves a waypoint where you die.
isomap.setting.waypoints.deathMarkersVis: Draws death markers on the maps; they always stay in the list.
isomap.setting.waypoints.deathChatMessag: Reports coordinates and dimension in chat after a death.
isomap.setting.waypoints.deathMarkersMax: Older death markers are removed above this number.
isomap.setting.pings.enabled.hint: Temporary markers you place for others, and see from them.
isomap.setting.pings.throughChat.hint: Servers without IsoMap: pings go as chat lines. Everyone sees them, with coordinates.
isomap.setting.pings.durationSeconds.hin: How long a ping stays on your screen.
isomap.setting.sounds.enabled.hint: Master switch for all interface sounds.
isomap.setting.sounds.volume.hint: Volume of the interface sounds; the game's master volume applies too.
isomap.setting.sounds.hover.hint: Pointing at a control. Rate-limited to avoid spam.
isomap.ping.local_only: This server has no IsoMap: only you see the ping. Chat sending is in the settings.
isomap.setting.controls.wheelZoomWhileHo: Zooms the HUD map with the wheel while the camera key is held.
isomap.map.title: Map
isomap.map.help: Left drag: turn and tilt.  Right drag: move, right click: menu.  Wheel: zoom.  Double click: new waypoint.  Middle click: ping.
isomap.waypoints.title: Waypoints
isomap.edit.title: Edit waypoint
isomap.edit.name: Name
